extDescription.message: Saves a fanfic from the open page as TXT or HTML: AO3, Ficbook and FanFiction.net.

popupOpenSupported.message: Open a work on one of the sites below.

popupOpening.message: Opening the work in a tab…

errTabClosed.message: The tab was closed before it loaded

errNotArchive.message: The address is not in the archive list

runSavedCopy.message: File saved to Downloads. AO3 is unavailable — source: $1.

copyWaybackPartial.message: Wayback Machine copy from $1 (may contain only the first chapter)

stageAo3saver.message: AO3 is unavailable — looking for a copy on ao3saver…

stageWayback.message: Looking for a copy in the Wayback Machine…

stageWait.message: The site asks to wait — continuing in $1 s

errAo3Down.message: AO3 is unavailable right now, and no saved copy of this work was found on ao3saver or in the Wayback Machine. Try again later — status: status.archiveofourown.org.

errLogin.message: This work is only available after logging in to $1.

errRateLimited.message: The site has temporarily limited access. Try again in a few minutes.

errCloudflare.message: The site blocked the request (Cloudflare check). Reload the page and try again.

errNotFound.message: Work not found: it may have been deleted or hidden.

errNoText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of this work.

errLayout.message: Couldn’t recognize the work page: the site may have changed its layout.

errNoChapterText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of chapter $1.

errNoPartText.message: The site doesn’t show the text of part $1.
